title: The NICER telescope on the ISS measures neutron star sizes precisely.
purpose: Highlight a specific mission and its results.
narration: Did you know that the NICER telescope on the International Space Station measures the sizes of neutron stars with incredible precision? By observing X-ray pulses from their surfaces, it reveals how matter behaves under extreme density and pressure. This data helps scientists uncover the fundamental nature of matter itself.

claims.text: The NICER telescope aboard the ISS measures neutron star sizes precisely.
It works by observing X-ray pulses from neutron star surfaces.
The measurements help understand matter under extreme density and pressure.
